Since all roots are negative integers, $f(x)=(x+p)(x+q)(x+r)(x+s)$ with $p,q,r,s$ positive integers. Then $d = pqrs$.

Evaluating at $x=1$ gives $f(1)=1+a+b+c+d=2010$, so
$$(1+p)(1+q)(1+r)(1+s)=2010=2\cdot 3\cdot 5\cdot 67.$$

Each factor $1+p$ is at least 2, and $2010$ has exactly four prime factors. Each factor must therefore be a single prime, so $\{1+p,1+q,1+r,1+s\}=\{2,3,5,67\}$, giving $\{p,q,r,s\}=\{1,2,4,66\}$.

Thus $d = 1\cdot 2\cdot 4\cdot 66 = 528$.

ANSWER: 528
